description: Generate a smooth gradient between colors with multiple interpolation methods (oklch, oklab, lab, lch, hct, hsl, rgb)

interpolation.description: Color space for interpolation (oklch/oklab/lab/lch/hct are perceptually smooth)

steps.description: Total number of colors in the gradient, including every input color (must be ≥ number of colors)

name: generate_gradient
